info.title: Hybrid Quantum-AI Cyber Defense API (research prototype)
info.description: Defensive, RECOMMENDATION-ONLY research API. Recommendations are read-only and always require human approval; analyst decisions are recorded, never executed. Risk scores are MODEL-DERIVED. No quantum advantage is claimed.

get.description: Liveness check. Reports configuration labels only (no paths or secrets).
Versions of the knowledge base, models and policies; the API's safety contract.
The SYNTHETIC integration scenario (hand-authored; never real-world data).

post.description: Correlate observations (arrival order, never sorted) into incident chains.
Next-technique probabilities and beam path scores (PREDICTED, never observed).
MODEL-DERIVED RISK SCORE for one chain (quantum evidence contributes 0 points).
Run the full pipeline on the submitted observations and store the (immutable) result.

schema.title: Response List Assessments Api V1 Assessments Get

get.description: Recommendations of an assessment (each requires human approval; none is executed).

schema.title: Response List Recommendations Api V1 Assessments  Assessment Id  Recommendations Get
Response List Decisions Api V1 Assessments  Assessment Id  Recommendations  Recommendation Id  Decisions Get

post.description:
Append an analyst decision to the audit log. RECORDED ONLY - nothing is executed.

Approving a HIGH-disruption recommendation requires an earlier ACKNOWLEDGED decision
(two-step acknowledgement).

get.description: Stored experiment records (summaries only: no paths, environment or configuration).

AttackChain.title: AttackChain
AttackChain.description:
An ordered sequence of attack steps.

Order is significant and is never re-sorted: if timestamps are present they must
already be non-decreasing, otherwise validation fails.

timestamp.description: Event time. May be absent for knowledge-base sequences.

source.description: Origin of the step, e.g. a mapping table or flow.

Decision.title: Decision
Decision.description: Analyst workflow decisions. Recording a decision executes nothing.

notice.title: Notice

target.description: Entity the analyst should consider acting on.

approval_note.title: Approval Note
approval_note.default: RECOMMENDATION ONLY - requires human approval; the system executes nothing.

DefenseRecommendation.title: DefenseRecommendation
DefenseRecommendation.description: An advisory action for a human analyst to consider.

DetectionEvidence.title: DetectionEvidence
DetectionEvidence.description: Classical decision plus optional quantum second opinion for one event.

EvidenceRef.title: EvidenceRef
EvidenceRef.description: Pointer to the evidence that triggered a recommendation.

EvidenceSource.title: EvidenceSource
EvidenceSource.description: Where a technique attribution comes from. No source is trusted by default.

chain.description: OBSERVED steps in arrival order (never re-sorted).

documented_steps.title: Documented Steps
documented_steps.description: DOCUMENTED CTI steps (e.g. Attack Flow); not events.

out_of_vocabulary_technique_ids.title: Out Of Vocabulary Technique Ids
out_of_vocabulary_technique_ids.description: Observed IDs not active in ATT&CK 19.2 (<UNK>).

IncidentChain.title: IncidentChain
IncidentChain.description: Reconstructed incident: observed steps, documented reference steps, and context.

claim_policy.title: Claim Policy
claim_policy.default: No quantum advantage is claimed; quantum kernels are simulated on a CPU.

cic_label_policy.title: Cic Label Policy
cic_label_policy.default: CIC-IDS2017 attack labels are not MITRE ATT&CK techniques; no such mapping is applied.

ScenarioDetection.description: Hand-authored detector scores (SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE); not produced by any trained model.

TechniqueCandidate.title: TechniqueCandidate
TechniqueCandidate.description:
A candidate technique produced by mapping, with confidence and evidence.

A single network flow rarely identifies a technique uniquely, so mappings
produce one or more candidates rather than a single answer.

tactic_id.title: Tactic Id
tactic_id.description: Tactic the evidence attributes (must be a tactic of the technique).

reference.title: Reference
reference.description: Rule ID, scenario ID@version, Attack Flow document or detector version.

TechniqueEvidence.title: TechniqueEvidence
TechniqueEvidence.description: One piece of evidence that an ATT&CK technique occurred (or is documented).
